name: Audio Synth Keyboard
summary: Synthesizer keyboard CodeComponent using Tone.js extension for audio synthesis. Features Tone.PolySynth with configurable oscillator type (sine, square, sawtooth, triangle) via Select. ADSR envelope controls with 4 Sliders for attack, decay, sustain, release. Switch toggles for Tone.Reverb and Tone.FeedbackDelay effects. DropdownMenu with 5 presets (Piano, Organ, Strings, Bass, Lead). Interactive piano keyboard spanning 2 octaves (C4-B5) with white and black keys, pointer events for triggerAttack/triggerRelease. Visual feedback on active notes with theme-aware highlight colors. Uses useAppState for synth patch state, useTheme for key colors.
shortSummary: Tone.js synthesizer keyboard with ADSR sliders, oscillator select, effects, and presets
